content.value_statement: Release decisions often rely on incomplete evidence and inconsistent standards. This skill applies structured controls, deterministic scoring, and mandatory gates to assess readiness.
actual_capabilities: Selects audit controls by depth tier, product profile, and documented applicability.
Guides evidence collection across security, reliability, architecture, quality, privacy, accessibility, operations, and delivery.
Records control statuses, findings, limitations, and sanitized evidence in defined audit artifacts.
Calculates weighted category scores, coverage, caps, and mechanical release blockers with a bundled Python scorer.
Requires independent challenge for standard and deep audits.
Produces a structured report, risk register, action plan, and release verdict.
limitations: Results depend on the access, authorization, evidence, and environments provided by the operator.
The scorer cannot evaluate qualitative gates without auditor judgment.
Active, destructive, load, or authorization testing requires explicit rules of engagement.
The skill does not replace specialized legal, regulatory, penetration testing, or certification services.

use_cases.title: Prepare a release decision
use_cases.description: Assess a candidate release against evidence coverage, quality controls, and mandatory gates before deployment.

use_cases.title: Run a structured security review
use_cases.description: Evaluate security and privacy controls while recording authorization, evidence, limitations, and remediation priorities.

use_cases.title: Measure production readiness
use_cases.description: Compare engineering quality across architecture, reliability, operations, accessibility, performance, and delivery practices.

prompt_templates.title: Start a rapid audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a rapid audit of this repository. Begin with scope, authorization, product profile, and missing intake information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an early release risk screen.

prompt_templates.title: Assess release readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a standard production-readiness audit for this release. Record evidence, limitations, control statuses, scores, coverage, findings, and release gates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a normal production deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Review a sensitive system
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a deep audit for this data-sensitive system. Define required access, evidence, controls, authorization boundaries, and independent verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for regulated data or high-consequence systems.

prompt_templates.title: Re-audit remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-audit the supplied prior findings against the current build. Verify remediation, regressions, remaining risks, current evidence, and changed scores.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after teams address an earlier audit.

output_examples.input: Audit this release at standard depth for a public web application.
output: Verdict: Requires rework because two release gates remain unresolved.
Coverage: 87 percent overall, with security and reliability above required thresholds.
Top actions: close the authorization gap, verify recovery, and resolve the high-severity access-control finding.

output_examples.input: Compare this build with the previous audit.
output: Four findings are remediated, one is partially remediated, and one has regressed.
The current build improves quality coverage but still lacks verified rollback evidence.
The release remains conditionally eligible after independent challenge.

best_practices: Define scope, authorization, environment, depth, and product profile before selecting controls.
Use affirmative, sanitized evidence and mark unsupported claims as unverified.
Keep scores separate from mandatory gates and independent review outcomes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat scanner silence or missing evidence as a passed control.
Do not run active tests outside explicit rules of engagement.
Do not remove applicable controls to improve coverage or scores.

faq.question: What audit depths are supported?
faq.answer: Rapid supports early screening, standard supports normal release decisions, and deep supports high-consequence or high-assurance reviews.

faq.question: Does the skill perform penetration testing?
faq.answer: It defaults to passive inspection. Active testing requires explicit authorization and may still require a qualified specialist.

faq.question: How are release scores calculated?
faq.answer: A bundled Python script applies category weights, control criticality, coverage rules, score caps, and mechanical release gates.

faq.question: Can a high score override a serious finding?
faq.answer: No. Mandatory gates and unresolved critical or high findings constrain the verdict regardless of the numeric score.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is unavailable?
faq.answer: The affected control remains unverified, and the missing evidence appears in audit limitations and coverage calculations.

faq.question: What artifacts does the skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a manifest, selected controls, evidence ledger, findings, scores, risk register, verification log, and final report.
